name: omawall
author: klieber (fork of matjam/omawall)
description: Folder-backed Omarchy backgrounds with per-workspace slots and a fit filter (no upscale, aspect buckets). Shuffle or pin per display, scale to taste, optional theme-from-wallpaper.

barWidget.description: Give each display its own wallpaper folder, shuffle or pin an image, choose how it scales, and optionally recolor Omarchy to match.

schema.label: Primary display
schema.description: Output whose wallpaper drives the generated theme. Empty uses the first connected display.

schema.label: Configure each display separately
schema.description: Off: every display shares one configuration.

schema.label: Per-display configuration
schema.description: Keyed by output name, plus an 'all' entry used when perDisplayConfig is off. Each holds folder, recursive, mode (shuffle or single), pinned and scaling (zoom, fitHeight, fitWidth or actual).

schema.label: Different image per display
schema.description: Within a group of displays sharing a folder, off mirrors one image across them.

schema.label: Different wallpaper per workspace
schema.description: On: each numbered workspace keeps its own picture. Off: every workspace on a display shows the same picture.

schema.label: Shuffle on unlock or wake
schema.description: Change wallpaper when you return to the session rather than on a timer.

schema.label: Generate theme from wallpaper
schema.description: Build an 'omawall' Omarchy theme from the primary display's wallpaper. Requires matugen.

schema.label: Wallpaper folder (legacy)
schema.description: Read only when displayConfig has no entry, so settings written before per-display support keep working. The first panel edit folds it into displayConfig.

schema.label: Search subfolders (legacy)
schema.description: As above; superseded by the per-display setting.
